habitats.description: Bushy tall grass and a variety of corals make this a perfect resting spot for Pokémon

habitats.name: Swaying flower bed
habitats.description: A cluster of small flowers and luxuriant leaves that sways gently to and fro

habitats.name: Swaying flower bed and coral
habitats.description: This gorgeous tableau of colorful corals and basin flowers can lift your mood

habitats.name: Swaying flower bed and seaweed
habitats.description: Flowers and seaweed sway gently beside rugged chimney rocks

habitats.name: Seaweed and netting
habitats.description: A bunch of seaweed near some netting. Somehow none of it gets tangled in the mesh.

habitats.name: Coral congregation
habitats.description: Colorful corals of various sizes. Pokémon who are coral connoisseurs find them irresistible

habitats.name: Sandy basin tall grass
habitats.description: Both the basin tall grass and the pile of sand are hiding spots for Pokémon

habitats.name: Sandy digging spot
habitats.description: Get your rake and shovel, then start digging until you find what you're after!

habitats.name: Sandy speech
habitats.description: Pokémon curious about the platform may pop out of the sandpile

habitats.name: Biteable punching bag
habitats.description: A punching bag hanging near a set of dentures. Pokémon with big jaws mayy be tempted to take a bite.

habitats.name: Marine mossy rest spot
habitats.description: The fluffy pink moss makes this spot very popular with aquatic Pokémon.

habitats.name: Molten mossy rest spot
habitats.description: Even the heat of the molten rock could not stop the thick growth of moss

habitats.name: Creepy chimney rocks
habitats.description: Creepy chimney rocks surrounded by sea moss. Pick up the lantern and take a closer look

habitats.name: Chimney rocks dig site
habitats.description: Dig around the chimney rocks to see if you can find any treasure!

habitats.name: Discarded treasure
habitats.description: A treasure chest that's been tossed out with the trash. Open it up and see what's inside!

habitats.name: Playing sailor
habitats.description: Turn the ship's wheel next to the treasure chest, just like a sea captain! Steady as she goes!

habitats.name: Treasure chest and sparkling jewels
habitats.description: Take the jewels out of the chest and illuminate them with the lantern.

habitats.name: Ocean rest spot
habitats.description: Sit on the cushion beside the coral and relax while gazing at the light.

habitats.name: Marine shop
habitats.description: Just power up the cash register, and you'll be ready for business in no time-even underwater!

habitats.name: Ocean treasures
habitats.description: Sparkling jewelry and a bottled ship. These should be stored very carefully

habitats.name: Smoothie-making spot
habitats.description: Grab some berries and a blender, and you'll be all set to make smoothies

habitats.name: Fluffy relaxation
habitats.description: The huge cushion bed and fluffy doll create a soothing environment

habitats.name: Canoe dock
habitats.description: A cozy little canoe dock. Pokémon may come by to ride the canoe

habitats.name: Muddy playtime
habitats.description: Have fun in the muddy water by playing with the toys or riding the floating logs.

habitats.name: Muddy spa
habitats.description: A luxurious spa with a large, prominent fountain. Taking a mud bath may turn your skin silky smooth

habitats.name: Topsy-turvy
habitats.description: A row of lampions hanging upside down, but that's fine as long as they shine brightly

habitats.name: Bubbly bathtub
habitats.description: Fill the tub and enjoy a fun bubbly bath time

habitats.name: Bubbly stage
habitats.description: Dance on a stage bursting with bubbles!

habitats.name: Glowing stage for three
habitats.description: A shiny stage perfect for a trio. Gather everyone and get singing!

habitats.name: Elegant concert
habitats.description: A harp that gleams in the lamplight. Try strumming a melody inspired by the ocean.

habitats.name: Marine teatime
habitats.description: Relax and enjoy teatime in a chic space while admiring a bottled ship.

habitats.name: Nostalgia zone
habitats.description: Listen to the melody of the music box and take a stroll down memory lane.

habitats.name: Marine makeup stand
habitats.description: An elegant space adorned with shell and pearl furniture. You could probably get extra stylish here.

habitats.name: Gorgeous Sleeping Area
habitats.description: Sleeping surrounded by gorgeously decorated furniture may help you drift into fancy dreams.

habitats.name: Mermaid's Gym
habitats.description: This space with a shining pearl sofa feels ready for someone to arrive

habitats.name: Yellow carpet
habitats.description: A field of warm, blooming yellow flowers. Just looking at it seems to fill you with energy

habitats.name: Field-trip friends
habitats.description: Pack a lunch box and canteen inside your backpack, and you're all set for a field trip

habitats.name: Dandelion lunchtime
habitats.description: Lunch box? Check. Tableware? Check. Time for a picnic lunch break!

habitats.name: Treasure-hunting set
habitats.description: A map and compass are essential treasure-hunting tools. Time to set off in search of jewels

habitats.name: Surrounded by stars
habitats.description: Surrounded by shining stars and fluffy clouds, you'll feel like you're living in a dream

habitats.name: Exciting beach
habitats.description: Relax in the cute sand bed or play with the huge swim ring

habitats.name: Marine leisure activities
habitats.description: Enjoy the beach to the fullest by playing volleyball or relaxing on the swim ring.
